newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -U.S. T-bonds to glean support from 111-17.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -U.S. T-bonds to glean support from 111-17.

text.p: September T-bond futures are losing steam, but dips to 111-17 should be bought as the upward trend channel remains unscathed, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"The market is rangebound ahead of auctions (this week). I wouldn't be surprised to see both sides trade," said Stavros Loizou, manager of strategic trading at Fuji Bank in London.
But he added, "We are in an upward trending channel and the market should be bought on dips."
He saw support initially coming in at Tuesday's intraday low of 111-29, followed by the double bottom at 111-17 on June 17, 18.
On the upside, gains for the day could be limited to around 112-17, the close on Friday, or 112-24, the high on Friday, Loizou said.
By 0905 GMT, September T-bond futures had shed 2/32 to 112-03.
Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch in London, also said he was looking for T-bonds to back down from present levels.

"The market is looking a bit fatigued, it's come up against some major resistance," he told Reuters Financial Television. "I tend to think it will back down from here...and break below 111-23 to aim for 111-00 over the next week."
He said the Federal Open Market Committee meeting next Tuesday and Wednesday and payrolls data next Friday would prevent the market from gunning for higher ground near term.
Daily charts show the market hit a low of 111-23 on June 16.
September Eurodollar futures were trading 0.005 lower on the day at 94.135.
